<b>Dejected Pilgrim</b> is an [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPC]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are one of the few hardy pilgrims to have reached [[the Citadel]], found resting near the [[Bench (Silksong)|Bench]] in [[Songclave]] in [[Act 3]].

== In-game Events ==
Hornet can meet the Dejected Pilgrim in Songclave once [[Act 3]] has begun. They express fear about the new disaster that affects Pharloom, asking whether it is a punishment, or a test of faith. Hornet assuages them that it is neither, letting them know that she seeks to put an end to their plight.

Once their dialogue has been exhausted, they have a 25% chance of being gone the next time Hornet reenters the room after resting elsewhere. Once they have left, they remain absent for the rest of the game.

== Location ==
Dejected Pilgrim can be found sitting in Songclave near the bench after the start of Act 3.
